name: tts-eval-seed
description: Speech-generation evaluation corpus v1: English, Hindi, and mixed text organized by trap category and difficulty (SPEECH_EVALUATION.md section 5). Immutable once cited by results; new coverage = version 2. URL/email categories are hard by design - expected low scores, tracked for improvement.

provenance.author: IntelliAI (in-house)
provenance.rationale: Seed corpus for the first TTS baseline (M2.5): trap-dense coverage of the categories speech generation typically fails - numbers, dates, currency, URLs, Devanagari conjuncts and matras, code-mixed Hinglish - sized for minutes-long evaluation runs.
